turns.title: Landing page plan
turns.plan:
# Landing page from the three stills

## Summary

One new page that shows the three selected stills as a hero and a gallery, with the headline from the prompt on the board.

## Key changes

- Write one page with page_write, placed beside the selection.
- Use the first still as the hero, full width, with the headline over it.
- Put the other two stills side by side under the hero.
- Inline all style and script, and name each picture by its file name.
- Leave the stills and the prompt exactly as they are.

## Checks

- The page opens in the editor and shows all three stills.
- The headline matches the prompt word for word.
- Nothing else on the canvas moves.

## Assumptions

- A light background, since the stills are dark.
- One column on a narrow screen.
